gloss: accounts receivable; money owed by customers

definitions.explanation: Money a business is owed for goods or services it has already delivered on credit. A standard balance-sheet asset account, and the counterpart of {買掛金|かいかけきん}.

examples.japanese: {売掛金|うりかけきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売掛金|うりかけきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: Collection of this month's receivables is running late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒産|とうさん}→倒産：03452_tousan⟧し、{売掛金|うりかけきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧⟦できなく→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: A client went bankrupt, and we became unable to collect the receivable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{売掛金|うりかけきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らんで→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧⟦{手元|てもと}→手元：07605_temoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: Sales are growing, but receivables have swollen and we are short of cash on hand.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧ (selling) + {掛|か}け (on credit) + {金|きん} (money). Used in bookkeeping and everyday business talk alike; ordinary speech often says {未回収|みかいしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売掛金|うりかけきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧: to collect a receivable
- {売掛金|うりかけきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to have a receivable outstanding
- {売掛金|うりかけきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: receivables balance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買掛金|かいかけきん}→買掛金：30204_kaikakekin⟧: accounts payable — the mirror image, money the business owes
- ⟦{未収金|みしゅうきん}→未収金：30183_mishuukin⟧: accrued receivable — money owed from something other than normal sales
- ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧: sales revenue — the sale itself, whether paid in cash or on credit
